editorial.blurb: A welcoming neighborhood spot where locals gather for solid American fare, cold drinks, and the kind of buzzy atmosphere that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the rack of ribs with the jalapeño cheese sauce for dipping—but ask for sauce on the side if you prefer it pre-applied. Swing by on trivia night to catch the local energy at its peak.

topDishes.note: tender and flavorful, pairs perfectly with house jalapeño cheese sauce
